email_subject: Possible adverse event report - DemoZanix ER patient with a mild skin rash
email_body:
[SYNTHETIC / FICTIONAL DATA — educational prototype only, no real patient or reporter information]

Hello Safety Team,


I am a nurse practitioner at Fictional General Hospital (demo) (a fabricated organization) and I would like to report a possible adverse event.

A 36-year-old female patient with a history of generalized anxiety disorder received their second dose of DemoZanix ER (dose: 50mg) via subcutaneous injection.
Treatment started on 2026-01-19.
Approximately 8 day(s) after that dose, the patient developed a mild skin rash.

Please let me know if you need anything else.

Regards,
R. Okafor (fictional reporter)
Fictional General Hospital (demo)
Contact: demo.reporter770@fictionalclinic-demo.example (synthetic contact info)
